Name: Naarah
Summary: Wife of Ashur the father of Tekoa and mother of Ahuzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:5: Wife of Ashur the father of Tekoa and mother of Ahuzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari.
LifeLesson: The mention of Naarah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
